definitions.explanation: The act of entering a venue again after having left, such as a concert hall, stadium, theme park, or exhibition. Often subject to specific rules or restrictions. Composed of {再|さい} (again) + {入場|にゅうじょう} (entry).

examples.japanese: {再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦できます→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧です。
examples.english: Re-entry is not permitted at this event.

examples.japanese: {再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手|て}の{甲|こう}→手の甲：06438_tenokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When re-entering, please show the stamp on the back of your hand.

notes:
USAGE:
{再入場|さいにゅうじょう} is commonly seen on signs and in event rules. It can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a verbal noun: {再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to re-enter). Many venues stamp visitors' hands or provide wristbands for re-entry.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧ (no re-entry)
- {再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧ (re-entry allowed)
- {再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to re-enter)
- {再入場|さいにゅうじょう}⟦スタンプ→スタンプ：11577_sutanpu⟧ (re-entry stamp)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧ means entry or admission.
- ⟦{退場|たいじょう}→退場：14353_taijou⟧ means exit or leaving.
- ⟦{入場券|にゅうじょうけん}→入場券：19454_nyuujouken⟧ means admission ticket.
